# MidwayRegistry

<!-- generated by scripts/render.mjs from data/ ; do not edit -->

Registers applications and their authorized purchasing accounts. An application has one         admin and any number of bound accounts; a bound account may name one operator to drive         its account-only Buyer calls without holding the account's own key.

**Address**: not yet deployed. `midway-v1` is pending deployment.
**Source**: `src/midway/MidwayRegistry.sol`

| `registerApplication(address,address,address)` | Registers an application with `msg.sender` as its admin. `account == msg.sender`         binds the account immediately, since the caller already proves control of it.         `account == address(0)` registers with no bound account. Any other nonzero address is         invited and binds on `acceptApplication`, the path for a contract account deployed         after registration. |
| `scheduleOpenAccess(uint64)` | Schedules the timestamp at which any registered application may acquire without an         explicit allowlist entry. Operator, once: a plain future timestamp with no relation         to any other contract's cycle schedule. |
| `setAccountOperator(address,address)` | Authorizes `operator` to make `account`'s account-only Buyer calls. Callable by the         account itself or the admin of `account`'s bound application. Zero clears it. The         operator cannot acquire, cannot change the account binding, and cannot change any         recipient. |
| `setAccountStatus(address,uint8)` |  |
| `setApplicationAllowed(uint256,bool)` |  |
| `setApplicationStatus(uint256,uint8)` |  |
| `setDefaultAutoSettleEth(uint256,bool)` | Sets the default `autoSettleEth` `MidwayBuyer.acquire()` uses when the caller         supplies none. Existing requests keep their snapshot. |
| `setPurchaserRewardRecipient(uint256,address)` |  |
| `setSharedUpsideAwardRecipient(uint256,address)` |  |
